title: worker_deduplicate_successful_tasks does not see a copy the publisher sent again after a lost reply: the task runs again after its SUCCESS
where: docs/userguide/configuration.rst:3653-3655 (celery 768e476): only messages redelivered by the broker are checked
thread: none needed: documented; worth a sentence in the idempotency Discussion draft
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, redis-py 8.1.0, a real prefork worker on Redis with dedup on; the publisher's replies dropped for 1.5 s by Toxiproxy (injected) with a 1 s socket timeout: 2 of 3 runs the task ran twice, SUCCESS stored before the second run, nothing skipped (the first run connected inside the drop and published once).
